data.name: Zhai
data.detailed_description:
OPEN WORLD ACTION ADVENTURE

lost memories unleash new ways to flight

Become Zhai, a warrior who has lost both his name and memories. Journey across Il'Navir, a divided world inhabited by rival tribes and recover the memories you have lost. 

Each recovered memory unlocks new abilities and attacks.

Forge your own combat style by unlocking multiple elemental abilities and chain them into a wide range of attacks

PROGRESSION 

Utilise The Memory Skill Tree to upgrade skills

Zhai's lost memories are more than a story mystery. Each recovered memory unlocks new abilities and attacks while gradually revealing more of his past. The Memory Skill Tree is Zhai's distinctive progression system, turning lost memories directly into new ways to fight. Growing stronger is itself part of the journey to discover who Zhai really is. 

ACTION

Combine your powers and control the battlefield

Through the tribes he encounters on his journey, Zhai gains a variety of elemental powers, manipulate gravity, chain abilities and attacks into into extended combos against powerful enemies and sweep away groups of foes. Upgrades change not only power, but also utility and synergise with other abilities. Combine your powers and build a combat system of your own.   

WORLD

Journey across the divided world of Il'Navir

From lands locked in snow and ice to hidden regions filled with towering rock formations and plant life, from settlements built in the sky, traverse across Il'Navir, home to breathtakingly diverse environments. Explore it's vast biomes and encounter tribes with distinct cultures, local creatures and hostile forces. 

STORY

Your past will shape the future of this world

Zhai has lost both his name and memories. His awakening on Il'Navir sets in motion an ancient threat believed to have vanished long ago. Divided tribes, struggles for power and a returning danger shape his journey. As Zhai connects with the tribes and recovers his lost memories, he begins to understand what his existence means for this world. 

BACKGROUND

Zhai was born from a world seen in a coma

The world of Il'Navir was born from an experience of one of The Orange Giant's founders. After a motorcycle accident left him in a coma, he experienced an extraordinarily vivid place he later described as ''another world''.  After regaining consciousness, he began sketching what he remembered. Those sketches grew into a game concept, eventually leading to the founding of The Orange Giant and the development of Zhai.

data.short_description: Lost memories unleash new ways to fight. Become Zhai, a warrior who has lost both his name and memories. Journey through the divided world of Il’Navir in this third–person open-world action-adventure. Unlock elemental powers through specific tribal trials to forge your own combat style.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500k (4 core 3.3 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4core 3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (4 GB) or AMD R9 290X (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX feature 11_1 required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-6600k (4 core 3.5 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 5 2400 G (4 core 3.6 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD RX 570 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX feature 11_1 required
